summary: Round-6 testing for AbodeOps live location tracking feature (Driver mini-map / Cleaner enroute-location-complete lifecycle / Owner Live Crew Map). Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_live_tracking.py with 9 tests targeting only the new endpoints — 9/9 PASSED. Verified: (a) POST /api/jobs/{id}/enroute by assigned cleaner sets tracking=true and stamps enroute_at; (b) POST /api/jobs/{id}/location updates position and returns {ok:true}; (c) both endpoints return 403 for a non-assigned user (verified with owner@abodeops.com hitting demojob_1); (d) PRIVACY LEAK CHECK — GET /api/jobs/{id} as owner AND as assigned cleaner does NOT contain a 'cleaner_locations' field (enrich_job correctly strips it at server.py:433); (e) GET /api/fleet/live returns 403 for cleaner role; (f) GET /api/fleet/live as owner returns owner's active jobs each with a 'live_cleaners' array, where every item has user_id/name/latitude/longitude/phase/updated_at and phase ∈ {enroute,on_site}; (g) cross-owner isolation — t1@test.com (legacy_owner) calling /fleet/live does NOT see owner@abodeops.com's demojob_1; (h) POST /api/jobs/{id}/complete sets status=completed and tracking=false AND the completed job no longer appears in /fleet/live (filtered out by status query in pending/in_progress). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): (1) OWNER live-map-card visible on dashboard at testID 'live-map-card' → tapping navigates to /live-map → '1 live' badge renders, legend chips (On the way, On site, Pending job, In progress) render, web fallback job-map renders with a person row 'Casey Cleaner · On the way · live location' (testID map-person-{uid}) and three job marker rows (testID map-marker-{job_id}); tapping a job marker opens the peek card with live-peek-view CTA which routes to /job/demojob_3 successfully. (2) CLEANER Driver Mode → going online (forced via API to bypass the Switch toggle issue noted below, then re-confirmed Switch click does flip the UI) the mini-map (web fallback) renders ABOVE the Nearby Offers (3) list with a 'Map preview (live map renders on the mobile app)' banner; offers list shows 3 demo jobs with distance/pay/time; earnings $270 today/week/total. (3) CLEANER job lifecycle on /job/demojob_1 (cleaner already grabbed it via /jobs/grab + backend enroute): the page initially renders Accept/Decline/Request More Info buttons because grab does NOT set cleaner_responses[uid]='accepted' (see backend issue below). After tapping accept-job-button, the action bar correctly transitions to show the tracking-indicator ('Sharing live location with the job poster') because enroute_at is already set on the job. The onmyway-button itself was not directly tappable in this test because backend was pre-enroute; logic in /app/frontend/app/job/[id].tsx:259-267 confirms onmyway-button -> enroute call -> tracking-indicator state machine is wired correctly. No DOM leak of 'cleaner_locations' on the rendered job page. No console errors during the full owner+cleaner flow.

minor.issue: Does NOT set cleaner_responses.{user_id}='accepted'. Because grab is described as 'instant one-tap accept' (test_credentials.md), the assigned cleaner is then forced through an extra Accept/Decline/Request-More-Info step on /job/{id} before the 'On My Way' button can appear (the action bar gate is `isAssigned && status==='pending' && myResp==='accepted'`). Either grab should auto-set myResp='accepted', OR job/[id].tsx should treat grab-assigned jobs as accepted by default. server.py L1108-1111.
server.py L433 comment says 'exposed only via /jobs/live to the poster' — actual route was renamed to /fleet/live. Update comment to avoid future confusion.

critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py L1153-1176 fleet/live correctly filters by poster_id, 60-min staleness, and phase != completed. Privacy is enforced ONLY at scope level (poster_id == user_id); the role check at L1155 allows 'client' role which means a client poster could see their own job's cleaner positions — verify this is intended (the review_request restricts visibility to 'job poster, never public' which is consistent).

/app/backend/server.py L1118-1132 _set_job_location uses dot-path $set which is correct, but does not validate latitude/longitude ranges. A malformed value (e.g. lat=999) would be stored and shown on the owner's map. Add Pydantic constraints (ge=-90/le=90 and ge=-180/le=180).

/app/backend/server.py L626-645 complete_job correctly sets tracking=false and phase='completed' on the cleaner's slot — but it leaves the lat/lng values intact in cleaner_locations. Since fleet/live filters completed phase out, this is safe; however the 60-min staleness check on `at` is updated to now_utc() at completion which means a completed slot will technically stay 'recent' but be excluded by the phase filter. Acceptable.

/app/frontend/app/job/[id].tsx L80-84 onMyWay handler falls back to job.latitude/longitude when device coords are unavailable (web) — good. But it always sends the location even when getCoords returns null on native with denied permission — that's also fine because backend just stores whatever is sent.
/app/frontend/app/job/[id].tsx L39-54 the 15-second polling useEffect calls /jobs/{id}/location on native only; this is correct. Verify the interval is cleared on unmount (it is, via clearInterval).

/app/frontend/app/live-map.tsx L10 POLL_MS=8000 — 8s poll on /fleet/live is reasonable. Consider increasing to 10–15s on web to reduce idle traffic, or use visibilityState to pause when tab is hidden.
/app/frontend/src/components/JobMap.web.tsx is missing top padding so it slides under the SafeAreaView header on /live-map (see design_issues).

seed_data_creation: Re-ran /app/backend/seed_demo.py twice. For UI tests, used the API to grab+enroute demojob_1 as cleaner@abodeops.com so the owner's /fleet/live would show '1 live' Casey Cleaner during testing. test_live_tracking.py uses demojob_1 (enroute path) and demojob_2 (complete-clears-tracking path); both are demo jobs that get re-seeded by seed_demo.py.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `cd /app/backend && python seed_demo.py` then `pytest tests/test_live_tracking.py -v` for the 9-test live-location regression. BASE_URL from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Demo jobs: demojob_1 (used as the enroute target) and demojob_2 (used for complete-clears-tracking). The privacy contract is: /api/jobs/{id} GET (any role) MUST NOT contain 'cleaner_locations'; locations are exposed ONLY via /api/fleet/live to poster_id. /fleet/live is owner_cleaner/company_owner/client/admin only — cleaner role gets 403. For frontend testing of the 'On My Way' button itself, you need a cleaner who has been _explicitly_ assigned by an owner (so they hit the Accept/Decline flow) and then taps Accept — the onmyway-button then appears. Alternatively grab a fresh demojob_3 as cleaner, then explicitly POST /jobs/demojob_3/respond {action:'accept'} as cleaner before opening the job page — that puts the action bar in the onmyway-visible state.
rca_of_issue: POST /api/jobs/{id}/grab (server.py L1092-1115) atomically assigns the cleaner but does not set cleaner_responses[uid]. The /job/[id].tsx action-bar logic gates the onmyway-button on `isAssigned && status==='pending' && myResp==='accepted'`. As a result, a grab-assigned cleaner sees 'Accept/Decline/Request More Info' instead of 'On My Way' on first open of the job detail. Mitigation (single line): add `"$set": {f"cleaner_responses.{user['user_id']}": "accepted"}` to the update_one call in grab_job (or merge into the existing $addToSet operation via a follow-up $set). All other live-tracking endpoints (enroute/location/complete/fleet-live) behave as specified.
